name: Lotus Kiln Rim
core_rationale: Northernmost vitrified porcelain lotus-petal rim of Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary at [1, 0] where Sola's inner shield-ridge meets the high thermal geysers.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Weavers claim that once every solstice, the giant porcelain lotus petals on the northern rim unfold to reveal a crystal stair into the clouds.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Curving white porcelain lotus petals rising out of golden geothermal mist on the northern horizon.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What celestial observatory did Sola's porcelain lotus petals originally shelter before the Clockspring War?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northernmost vitrified crest of scar-kiln-basin inside Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Colossal white porcelain lotus petals wreathed in golden geothermal mist.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: terrain tile and prop kit metrics for 1.05m characters will be bound when promoted to Canon.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: gated behind the North fog_of_lore portal on town-porcelain-loom-sanctuary.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null and complete mystery_hook without generating filler map geometry.
